runtime_resolution.authority_basis: GitHub Actions validates and transports evidence only. Task Registry substrate selection grants no execution authority. Interlock/InTr remains transition/admission authority, WorkerCoordinator remains claim/fence authority, TV/TVC remains credential authority, and Master Records remains observed-reality/reconstruction authority. Remote Computer transport presence or absence has authority_effect=NONE; an empty inventory is EVIDENCE_REACHABILITY only and cannot establish substrate unsuitability or an external-device requirement. Authentic portable dispatch evidence must retain source_revision_head_kind=GIT_HEAD, an exact lowercase 40-hex source_git_head, exact selector stegbrowser_tvc_source_promotion, exact one-consumer dispatch evidence, the current dispatcher outcome with attempted=true and returncode=0, the identity-valid dedicated StegBrowser consumption receipt, proof that target_consumption_matches_current_dispatch_result=true, and the dedicated receipt canonical SHA-256 commitment together. The dedicated receipt must bind task STEG-BROWSER-EPHEMERAL-RUNTIME-BINDING-001, pinned TVC SHA aef6b6f5dc99d2a531718ca475d20858ae8e68a6, zero credential material, zero network source fetch, and a staged outcome of STAGED, ALREADY_STAGED, or RESTAGED_EXACT_SOURCE. HANDOFF_READY cannot establish complete dispatch evidence. Source/CI state does not prove runtime execution. Signing private key material must originate, remain, and be destroyed inside the current-iPhone ephemeral signing executor.
